data.title: India's Securities and Exchange Board Proposes Continuing Indicative Equilibrium Prices During Closing Auction

data.title: South Korea's President Lee Jae-myung Says Domestic Refined Oil Prices and Supply Remain Stable
data.description: According to Jin10, South Korea's President Lee Jae-myung said that despite surging crude oil and international refined oil prices, South Korea is maintaining stable domestic refined oil prices and supply through a price cap system and export volume controls.

data.title: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung Says Oil Import Diversification Will Continue
data.description: According to Jin10, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung said he will continue to strongly promote diversification of crude oil imports.

data.title: South Korean President Lee Jae-myung Says Fuel Prices Will Remain Stable
data.description: According to Jin10, South Korean President Lee Jae-myung said South Korean citizens need not worry and that gasoline, diesel, and other refined oil prices will continue to remain stable.

data.title: Iranian Parliament National Security Committee Chair Ibrahim Azizi: No Negotiations
data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian Parliament National Security Committee Chair Ibrahim Azizi said there will be no negotiations and that talks are meaningless unless Iran's conditions are met.

data.title: Iran's Bushehr Airport Resumes First International Flight After Six-Month Suspension
data.description: According to Jin10, the head of the Bushehr Province Airport Administration said Bushehr Airport resumed its first international flight after a six-month suspension, with the Bushehr-Dubai route operated by Qeshm Air.

data.title: BIS Report Says AI Is Shrinking Banks' Window to Fix Software Flaws
data.description:
A new report from the Bank for International Settlements says advanced AI is shortening the time banks have to fix software flaws before attackers exploit them. According to ChainCatcher, the report warns that periodic security reviews and scheduled patch updates are increasingly insufficient, as the window between vulnerability discovery and exploitation has narrowed from weeks to minutes.

The report focuses on banks' response capabilities and argues that financial institutions must speed up software remediation and accelerate related authorization decision-making processes.

data.title: Iraqi Lawmaker Warns Against U.S. Interference in Domestic Affairs
data.description: According to Jin10, Iraqi lawmaker Mohammed al-Hassanawi warned against U.S. interference in domestic affairs, saying Iraq's cabinet has still not been fully formed because the United States controls many key sectors in Iraq and interferes in its domestic affairs.

data.title: Canada's OSFI Says Tokenized Deposits Are Legally Equivalent to Traditional Deposits
data.description:
Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions said tokenized deposits are not legally different from traditional deposits and that the underlying technology used in a financial product or service does not determine its legal nature. According to Odaily, the regulator said financial institutions can conduct tokenized deposit business under existing financial regulatory laws without additional rules.

OSFI said financial institutions and third parties acting on their behalf must ensure their activities comply with applicable laws and regulations. It also asked institutions to contact the OSFI supervisor responsible for oversight before launching new products or services and recommended seeking legal advice before going live. The agency oversees nearly 350 financial institutions and 1,200 pension plans.

data.title: Canada's OSFI Says Tokenized Deposits Are Legally Equivalent to Traditional Deposits
data.description:
Canada's banking regulator said tokenized deposits are not legally different from traditional deposits and that the underlying technology used in a financial product or service does not determine its legal nature. According to ChainCatcher, the Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions said financial institutions can offer tokenized deposit services under existing financial regulatory laws without additional rules.

The regulator said financial institutions and third parties acting on their behalf must ensure their activities comply with applicable laws and regulations. It also said firms should contact the OSFI supervisor responsible for oversight before launching new products or services and recommended seeking legal advice before going live. OSFI oversees nearly 350 financial institutions and 1,200 pension plans.

data.description: According to Jin10, Iranian Vice President and Atomic Energy Organization chief Mohammad Eslami has departed for Vienna to attend the 70th General Conference of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA).

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Fitch Warns Italy’s Fragmented Politics Could Threaten Its Rating
data.description:
Italy’s increasingly factional politics could threaten the country’s credit score, according to Fitch Ratings.

Fitch’s warning comes as Italy’s political landscape becomes more fragmented, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: Binance Wallet Adds Access to Esports Prediction Markets
data.description: Binance Wallet announced on X that users can access Esports Prediction Markets through the Binance App and Binance Wallet Web. In the Binance App, the path is Exchange, then Markets, then Prediction, then Esports, or Wallet, then Home, then Prediction, then View more, then Esports. On the web, users can navigate through Binance Web, then Trade, then Prediction, then Esports, or Binance Wallet Web, then Prediction, then Esports. The announcement said Prediction Markets are available only to users in eligible regions and may not be available to all users. No additional details were provided about availability beyond the regional restriction.

data.title: CAT Bonds May Help Insure Data Center Risk, Industry Experts Say
data.description:
According to CNBC, the rapid buildout of hyperscale data centers is creating tens of billions of dollars in concentrated physical assets and an insurance challenge that traditional markets may struggle to handle alone. Industry experts said catastrophe bonds, or CAT bonds, could help insurers and reinsurers transfer some of that risk to capital market investors over the coming months, though the market is still in its early stages.

Ethan Powell, principal and chief investment officer of Brookmont Capital Management, said no data center risk has yet reached the CAT bond market, but he expects the first dedicated data center CAT bond deal within the next 12 to 18 months. He said a single hyperscale campus could carry between $20 billion and $30 billion of insurable value, compared with roughly $66 billion outstanding across the entire CAT bond market.

Powell said the most likely entry point would be a traditional property catastrophe tranche covering risks the insurance-linked securities market already knows how to model, including hurricanes and earthquakes. He added that some of the biggest data center exposures, including fire, water damage, power outages and business interruption, are harder for the CAT bond market to price today.

The broader CAT bond market is on track for another record year, with issuance reaching $18.9 billion so far in 2026 as first-time buyers enter the market. Steve Evans, owner and editor-in-chief at Artemis.bm, said insurers and reinsurers recognize the benefits of the structure and that pricing of reinsurance and CAT bond spreads has softened. Hanni Ali, founder and CEO of Radix ILS, said lenders to data centers may also look to the market to offload risks tied to sabotage, war and cyberattacks.

data.title: PPP-Tracked Account Buys $54,000 in T1 to Beat HLE Ahead of LCK Playoff Match
data.description: PPP monitoring showed that an account with $46,000 in profits bought $54,000 worth of T1 to beat HLE in the LCK playoff losers' bracket final, with an average entry price of 40 cents and 136,907.3 shares purchased. According to Odaily, the match began at 1:00 p.m. on September 12, and the winner will advance to the final on September 13 against GENG for the LCK 2026 championship, while the loser will be eliminated. Both teams have already secured qualification for the World Championship.

data.title: UK Crypto Industry Enters Regulatory Rollout Phase, FCA to Open Licensing Window on September 30
data.description:
The UK crypto industry is entering a phase of regulatory implementation, with the Financial Conduct Authority set to open its crypto asset authorization application window on September 30. According to ChainCatcher, the new regulatory regime is expected to take effect in October 2027.

Zumo founder and CEO Nick Jones said long-standing regulatory uncertainty and counterparty risk had made financial institutions cautious about the UK crypto market, rather than reflecting a lack of interest in digital assets. He added that clearer rules are drawing traditional financial firms such as Hargreaves Lansdown into the market, while the industry is expected to move away from offshore operations, startup-style processes, and unregulated models, increasing the importance of compliance infrastructure and local service providers.

data.title: South Korean Container Ship Reaches UK Via Arctic Route
data.description: According to The Korea Herald, the Panstar Acro, the first South Korean container ship to sail through the Arctic shipping route, reached the port of Felixstowe in the United Kingdom at around 5 a.m. on Saturday, 21 days after leaving Busan on Aug. 22. The 2,758-TEU midsize container ship is carrying cargo as part of a voyage to assess the potential of the long-closed route linking the eastern and western ends of the Eurasian continent.

data.title: STOCKS | U.S. Limits Tanker Transit Through the Strait of Hormuz
data.description:
The United States has required tankers crossing the Strait of Hormuz to sail only during specific time windows in order to receive military protection. According to Sina Finance, the move comes after Washington stepped up attacks on vessels sailing at night.

Since May, Washington has provided air cover for ships taking the route along the Omani coast on the southern side of the strait to deter Iranian attacks and help ensure some oil can be exported out of the Gulf. Shipowners must apply through the U.S. Naval Coordination Center for Shipping and Naval Cooperation and Guidance, known as NCAGS, which then gives crews navigation coordinates and allows vessels to pass during broad nighttime windows under U.S. fighter protection.

Emails seen by the media showed that in early September, those transit windows were narrowed to two specific daily periods, with affected ships told to depart at designated times such as 9 a.m. One email said the center was currently providing dynamically adjusted recommended transit windows each day, while another said night transit was not the safest time of day for commercial shipping.

The U.S. Central Command, which oversees U.S. military operations in the Middle East, said the NCAGS emails spoke for themselves. Since the U.S. and Israel struck Iran in February, Iranian forces have attacked dozens of ships trying to pass through the disputed waterway. As both sides have intensified pressure on commercial shipping, the U.S. has shifted escort protection to fixed day and night periods.

data.title: ECB Governing Council Member Kocher Warns High Oil Prices Could Force More Rate Hikes
data.description: According to Jin10, ECB Governing Council member Martin Kocher warned that if oil prices continue to hover around $100 a barrel before year-end, the central bank will have to raise interest rates further. After the European Central Bank raised borrowing costs for the second time on Thursday, the Austrian central bank governor said inflation risks were higher than a few months ago because tensions in the Middle East remained elevated and energy prices stayed high. Since the collapse of the U.S.-Iran ceasefire agreement in early July, oil prices have risen more than 45% and moved above $100 a barrel, while European natural gas prices have nearly doubled since June to close to 80 euros per megawatt hour. Kocher said that if oil and gas prices move toward an adverse scenario, monetary policy must take those changes into account, and he added that inflation risks would intensify further.
